## X-Sense Home Security v1.6.7-11

- Choose **Use Local MQTT only** for an individual SBS50 detector under **Device transport**. The XS0B-MR and XS01-M support local smoke and end-of-life readings; the XH02-M supports local heat alarm readings. Selected detectors keep their existing entities without falling back to cloud data or commands. Other devices and cameras keep their existing cloud behavior.
- Local-only detectors restore retained state after a restart and become unavailable when the detector reports offline or Home Assistant loses its broker connection. A physical SBS50 still needs testing with its internet connection cut.
- Broker setup now waits for a matching station settings report. Saving the settings is separate from the station connecting to the broker.
- Keep cloud and local detectors separate if a cloud device ID is reused, prevent removal decisions before cloud discovery completes, and avoid extra entity updates from mixed reports containing local-only detectors.
- Declare the AWS libraries used by the integration as runtime dependencies.
